# Preface {.unnumbered #sec-preface}

::: {.content-visible when-profile="edition-preview"}
::: {.alkahest-preview-placeholder}
:::
:::

This deliberately small book is an executable specification for Alkahest. Each
example exists to expose formatting or conversion problems before a real
manuscript depends on the template.

The specimen carries Alkahest's baseline visual system.{{< alk-index technical-publishing id=template-goal >}} Individual books may
vary its identity later, but shared typography, hierarchy, color roles, and
component behavior remain testable here.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
